about: Pass 7 batch B (2026-10-09): comparator cells for the 26 openly licensed LLM sources in lone-batch-B.json (178 stranded own-model results). Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. 236 results (70 lab, 166 independent) plus 1 proposed comparison-only model (phi-4-reasoning-plus). Every row reuses the source_id and pinned URL of the source's existing own-model row; no ledger changes are needed (scope notes are in the .md). Effect (URL-matched runs, as lib/score.ts groups them): 85 of the 178 lone rows start counting, 9 were already counting through rows that lack a source_id (LongCat-2.0, Nemotron-Cascade), 84 stay lone; 10 further new multi-model runs come from extra rows of the same tables (CritPt, four simple-evals rows, five TAU rows). Merge: models first, then results via npm run import (it skips duplicates). held_for_owner holds owner decisions, incl. ready consolidation rows for sibling cards owned by batches A and C (not in results) and 4 existing Muse Glimmer rows that Meta's report says came from Artificial Analysis.
